title: thlaspi sylvestre subsp. ambiguum
intro: Thlaspi sylvestre subsp. ambiguum, commonly known as field penny-cress, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, and is believed to have therapeutic actions such as reducing oxidative stress and improving immune function. The bioactive constituents of field penny-cress include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glucosinolates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Thlaspi sylvestre subsp. ambiguum on human health.
